Honey Basted Chicken
By: Anonymous
Published: Friday, December 4, 2009 - 12:04am

Ingredients




2/3 cup butter, melted
1 cup honey
1/2 cup prepared mustard
2 tablespoons curry powder or chili sauce
2 (2 ½ - 3 lb.) chicken, cut up

Preparation

1 In large roasting pan combine melted butter, honey, mustard and curry powder or chili sauce. Place pieces of chicken in roasting pan and turn to coat with honey mixture. Arrange pieces, meaty side down and bake, uncovered in a 375 degree oven for 30 minutes, brushing with butter mixture once. Turn meaty side up. Bake, uncovered 15 to 20 minutes or more or until tender. Makes 10 to 12 servings.
